description: Figure 5 presents a three-part analysis of personalized preferences across seven personas (P1–P7), with a focus on Persona 6 (P6). Subfigure (a), labeled “Persona similarity heatmap,” displays a symmetric 7×7 matrix of Jensen-Shannon similarity scores between all persona pairs, ranging from 0.5 to 1.0. The heatmap uses a color gradient from red (lower similarity) to teal (higher similarity), with diagonal elements all equal to 1.00 (self-similarity). Subfigure (b), titled “P6: Matching statistics,” is a placeholder or empty gray box with no visible data, though the caption indicates it is intended to show preference matching frequency between P6 and other personas, quantified by question counts per frequency tier. Subfigure (c), “P6: Tok-5 unique answer items,” is a horizontal bar chart comparing the top-5 most frequent social groups and fairness topics in P6’s unique answers. The chart uses two color-coded categories: “Fairness Topics” (light blue bars) including clean water (67), basic healthcare (65), public transport (64), emergency services (62), and transit subsidies (60); and “Social Groups” (light brown bars) including DV victims (226), AIDS victims (212), 911 victims (199), drug victims (190), and famine victims (187). The x-axis represents count, ranging from 0 to 200. The figure collectively illustrates how P6’s preferences diverge from others and highlights the specific social and equity concerns most prominent in its unique responses.
